[[Toru Sakurai]] ([[SM024]]-present) }} '''Tupp''' (Japanese: '''タッパ''' ''Tupper'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|PTS}}. He is a member of [[Team Skull]], who often appears alongside [[Zipp]] and [[Rapp]], and acts as the leader of the trio. ==History== [[File:Tupp Alolan Grimer.png|250px|thumb|left|Tupp when he was younger]] ===Pre-series=== As a child, Tupp was a boy who sought to be popular with the girls at school. However, [[Ilima]] and his adorable {{p|Eevee}} attracted all of the attention, causing Tupp to develop a deep hatred towards him. At some point, he chose to join [[Team Skull]]. His desire for revenge for being an outcast during his school days attracted him to the group, where he is now flocked by his fellow {{tc|Team Skull Grunt|Grunts}}. ===''[[Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon]]''=== Tupp debuted in ''[[SM001|Alola to New Adventure!]]'', where he, [[Zipp]], and [[Rapp]] challenged {{an|Kiawe}} to a {{pkmn|battle}} with his {{TP|Kiawe|Charizard}} on the line. Tupp and the other {{tc|Team Skull Grunt|Grunts}} took on his {{TP|Kiawe|Turtonator}} nine against one, until {{Ash}} came to assist Kiawe with his {{AP|Pikachu}}. After a short battle, Tupp and his partners were defeated by Turtonator's [[Z-Move]] {{m|Inferno Overdrive}}, forcing them to retreat. In ''[[SM011|Young Kiawe Had a Farm!]]'', Tupp and his teammates attacked Kiawe and Ash, seeking revenge for their previous defeat. However, the trio was quickly defeated by Pikachu's {{m|Gigavolt Havoc}}. In ''[[SM024|Alolan Open House!]]'', Tupp and his teammates visited the [[Pokémon School]], where they stole some [[Poké Ride|Ride]] {{p|Tauros}} and started wreaking havoc at the school. They were soon confronted by {{Delia}}, who took the Grunts on using [[Ash's Litten]]. When Ash and {{ashcl}} arrived, Team Skull was soon sent off again by Pikachu's Gigavolt Havoc. In ''[[SM025|A Team-on-Team Tussle!]]'', Tupp and his teammates encountered {{TRT}} for the first time. Both teams fought over a [[Darkinium Z]], which Team Rocket managed to take. In ''[[SM027|A Glaring Rivalry!]]'', Tupp had a battle with {{an|Gladion}} but was quickly defeated by {{p|Lycanroc}}'s {{m|Stone Edge}}. In ''[[SM065|Turning Heads and Training Hard!]]'', Tupp learned about Ilima's return to the Pokémon School. In response, he led a group of Team Skull Grunts there to exact his revenge on him. However, not only were the Grunts easily defeated by Ilima's Eevee, but the female Grunts in the group fell in love with Ilima, making Tupp even angrier. In ''[[SM068|Real Life...Inquire Within!]]'', Tupp and his teammates confronted Ash during an attempt to take {{AP|Poipole}}. They had a battle, which eventually ended when Zipp's {{p|Garbodor}}'s arm became blocked and released a horrible smell. In ''[[SM084|The Shape of Love to Come!]]'', Tupp and his teammates encountered [[Mina]], a wandering artist. When Rapp demanded that Mina give up her {{p|Ribombee}}, Mina accepted, but only if they could best her in a drawing competition. Though Mina liked the Team Skull Grunts' drawings enough that she wanted to call it a tie, Tupp was angered by her criticism of his poor drawing and instead decided to battle her. Mina was assisted by the timely arrival of Ash, who defeated Tupp's Salandit with Pikachu. In ''[[SM099|We Know Where You're Going, Eevee!]]'', Tupp and Rapp fought over a {{pkmn2|wild}} [[Sandy|Eevee]] as the former wanted to use it to make himself popular with girls while the latter wanted Eevee because she found it cute. After being rescued by Ash's Pikachu, Eevee teamed up with [[Lana's Popplio]] to send the trio blasting off. In ''[[SM104|That's Some Spicy Island Research!]]'', Tupp and his teammates went to [[Poni Island]] under [[Plumeria]]'s orders. They had stolen radishes from [[Hapu]]'s field and were using them to lure and capture a number of {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Oricorio|Sensu Style}} {{p|Oricorio}} when they encountered Ash. They sent their Pokémon out to battle Ash, but were stopped when Hapu arrived. Hapu battled Team Skull using her {{p|Mudsdale}} and quickly defeated them. Plumeria showed up, unhappy with their efforts, and ordered them to follow her back. In ''[[SM115|The Dealer of Destruction!]]'', Tupp and his teammates arrived at the [[Shady House]] and told [[Guzma]] about {{an|Professor Kukui}}'s announcement of the [[Pokémon League]]. Tupp then accompanied Guzma, Plumeria, and his teammates to Melemele Island, briefly encountering Team Rocket before showing up at the Pokémon School to get Kukui's attention. In ''[[SM128|League Offenders and Defenders!]]'', Tupp and his teammates arrived at the [[Manalo Stadium]] to try and destroy the Pokémon League for Guzma's sake without telling him what they were doing. Their efforts were thwarted by Ash, Kiawe, and [[Hau]], who easily defeated their Pokémon. Afterwards, Guzma and Plumeria arrived and scolded the Grunts for their failure. In ''[[SM129|Battle Royal 151!]]'', Tupp competed in the [[Battle Royal]] preliminary round of the [[Manalo Conference]]. He and his teammates ganged up on Ilima and his Eevee, only to be defeated. In ''[[SM130|Battling Besties!]]'', Tupp watched Guzma battle Ilima alongside his fellow Team Skull Grunts and watched as his leader managed to defeat Ilima. In ''[[SM134|The Road to The Semifinals!]]'', Tupp and his teammates unsuccessfully attempted to intimidate {{an|Lana}} before her match against Guzma. Later, he cheered for Guzma during the battle. In ''[[SM135|The Final Four!]]'', Tupp and his teammates were spray-painting graffiti around Manalo Stadium when they were confronted by [[Mimo]]. Tupp and his teammates sent out their Pokémon to intimidate her, only to be stopped by Gladion and his {{TP|Gladion|Silvally}}. In ''[[SM136|Getting Down to The Ire!]]'' and ''[[SM137|The Wisdom Not to Run!]]'', Tupp cheered for Guzma during his battle against Ash and spoke to him following his loss. Though Guzma was ready to disband Team Skull, Tupp and the others were so fired up by the battle that they wanted stay by his side and learn to battle as well as he did. In ''[[SM146|Thank You, Alola! The Journey Continues!]]'', Tupp was briefly seen battling Guzma and his {{p|Golisopod}} for training. ===''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]''=== In ''[[JN112|Helping the Hometown Hero!]]'', Tupp appeared along with Guzma, Plumeria, and his fellow Grunts watching the [[Battle Royal]] match between Ash, Kukui, {{an|Gladion}}, and {{an|Kiawe}}. ==Character== Tupp is mean to other people and holds deep grudges. This is most evident in ''[[SM011|Young Kiawe Had a Farm!]]'', where he had {{p|Salandit}} shoot down the [[Poké Ride|Ride]] {{p|Pelipper}} that Ash was using as revenge for his [[SM001|previous defeat]]. Tupp is obnoxiously loud and often boasts of his strength in {{pkmn|battle}}. He tends to proclaim his hatred of [[Z-Move]]s following his defeats, but despite this, Tupp is open to the idea of using a Z-Move himself. Tupp shows little concern for his teammates, as shown in ''[[SM025|A Team-on-Team Tussle!]]'', where he abandoned his teammates in favor of getting the [[Z-Crystal]]. He even callously told a concerned Salandit to focus on the job. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} This listing is of Tupp's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: ===On hand=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Tupp |pkmn=Salandit (×3) |type1=Poison |type2=Fire |img=Tupp Salandit.png |cap=Tupp Salandit |epnum=SM001 |epname=Alola to New Adventure! |vajp=Kenta Miyake |vaen=Haven Paschall |desc=Tupp's three {{p|Salandit}} are his only known Pokémon. They first appeared in ''[[SM001|Alola to New Adventure!]]'' in which they took on [[Ash's Pikachu]] and [[Kiawe's Turtonator]], but were defeated by Turtonator's {{m|Inferno Overdrive}}. One of the Salandit later reappeared in ''[[SM011|Young Kiawe Had a Farm!]]'', where it was attacking {{Ash}} and {{an|Kiawe}}. It was soon defeated when Pikachu attacked [[Team Skull]] with {{m|Gigavolt Havoc}}. One of the Salandit appeared again in ''[[SM024|Alolan Open House!]]'', but it was defeated once again by Pikachu's [[Z-Move]]. In ''[[SM025|A Team-on-Team Tussle!]]'', Salandit attempted to get a [[Darkinium Z]], only for {{TRT}} to get it first. In ''[[SM027|A Glaring Rivalry!]]'', Salandit was sent out to battle {{an|Gladion}}'s {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Lycanroc|Midnight Form}} {{p|Lycanroc}}. It was defeated by Lycanroc's {{m|Stone Edge}}. In ''[[SM065|Turning Heads and Training Hard!]]'', Salandit took on [[Ilima]]'s {{p|Eevee}}. It was defeated after its opponent enhanced its stats with {{m|Extreme Evoboost}}. In ''[[SM068|Real Life...Inquire Within!]]'', Salandit battled Pikachu again during an attempt to catch {{AP|Poipole}}. However, the battle ended when Zipp's {{p|Garbodor}}'s arm became blocked, causing it to release a horrible smell. This prompted everyone to retreat. In ''[[SM084|The Shape of Love to Come!]]'', Salandit was drawn by Zipp as a part of a challenge from [[Mina]] to see whom could produce the best drawing of one of their Pokémon. When Tupp and his fellow Team Skull members became angry, they attacked Mina. With the help of Ash, Mina defeated the Team Skull trio and sent them running away in fear. In ''[[SM099|We Know Where You're Going, Eevee!]]'', Salandit was relaxing on the beach, only to be {{m|Tackle}}d by an [[Sandy|Eevee]]. Salandit was then used to attack Ash and his classmates, only to be sent flying by Eevee's {{m|Double-Edge}}. In ''[[SM104|That's Some Spicy Island Research!]]'', Salandit was sent out to battle [[Hapu]] and her {{p|Mudsdale}}. Mudsdale withstood all of Salandit, Zubat, and Garbodor's attacks before quickly defeating them with {{m|High Horsepower}}. Salandit reappeared in ''[[SM128|League Offenders and Defenders!]]'' and ''[[SM129|Battle Royal 151!]]''. At least one of Tupp's three Salandit is confirmed to be male. Tupp believes that one is close to evolving, seemingly unaware that male Salandit are unable to evolve into {{p|Salazzle}}.
